text: The multiple-extension test distinguishes owner-visible and other-extension space records and checks isSelfOwned. management permission exposes extensionId in the checked expectations; similarly named spaces may coexist. Preserve the actor/permission distinction in this API test instead of treating a space name as one global identity. This is the test contract inspected here, not a complete security audit of every spaces consumer. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.
title: Assert ownership visibility separately for extension-created spaces
